message.content: During their meeting at "Central Perk," Li Hua suggested several design elements for Yuriko's studio homepage. Specifically, Li Hua proposed including a blog section, visual components like images and videos, and testimonials. Li Hua also emphasized the importance of a welcoming and engaging design that could be achieved through soft and calming pastel colors, and he suggested integrating a user feedback section to enhance the user experience. Additionally, Li Hua recommended adding a call-to-action button at the end of each blog post to encourage reader engagement and community building. These design elements were aimed at creating a visually appealing and user-friendly homepage that could effectively showcase Yuriko's speech therapy studio and its services.
